pages.title: Contamination Effects
pages.text: So you've contaminated your sample. What hardships would await you if you choose to equip the gene vial anyway? This entry will list the details on the 5 contamination types we know of today. Rusk Co. does not condone the usage of contaminated genes.

pages.title: Heliophobia
pages.text: The user's skin will form clear, crystalline structures, magnifying the Sun's rays and igniting victims exposed to it without any cooling.

pages.title: Hydrophobia
pages.text: Makes large quantities of water toxic to the victim. Smaller quantities should still be consumed regularly to maintain relative health.

pages.title: Genetic Destabilization
pages.text: The Genes across the body are rewired in strange and inefficient ways, occasionally causing overheating to the point of spontaneous combustion.

pages.title: Stagger
pages.text: Forcibly lowers the guard of the victim by always having them ever so slightly off balance, increasing any damage taken.

pages.title: Knee Pastafication
pages.text: Makes the victim's knees prone to being unstable, especially under heavy loads. The victim will be unable to move conventionally for a few seconds upon taking fall damage.

pages.title: Giant
pages.text: Makes the victim rapidly grow in size. Their reach will grow to compensate, but no other physical statistics will increase as one may usually expect from becoming giant.

pages.title: Glass Bones
pages.text: Enzymes produced by the gene crystallize the calcium in the victim's bones into a glass-like substance, reducing their maximum health.

pages.title: Shady
pages.text: This gene will make the victim give off bad vibes that villagers don't appreciate.
